name: animated-chart

frames.best_why: Both cards are fully drawn: line complete and the blue area filled under it.

tagline: Area chart whose line draws itself across a grid before the fill rises.
summary: A small chart card with a metric in the corner and a jagged line chart over a square grid. On load the line traces itself left to right and the shaded area underneath fades in.
appearance: Two rounded chart cards on dark, each with a small label and a bold headline value top left over a fine square grid. A pale blue line traces a jagged upward trend, and a soft blue fill sits beneath it to the bottom edge.
behaviour: The line starts as a stub at the bottom left and draws along its whole path in about half a second, then the filled area under it fades in from nothing to a soft blue wash. Each card replays on a loop.
demo_content: Two cards: Revenue, this month at +300% and Active users at 48.2k.
search_phrases: data viz card with grid background
use_when: A dashboard or landing page wants a small chart with a headline number that animates once on reveal.
avoid_when: The path and data are hardcoded, so it shows no real series and no axes; use a real chart when values must be accurate.
customise: Label, headline value and width come from props; the line path and grid are fixed in the source, so changing the shape or colours means editing the file.
weight_why: Two SVG paths animated once for under a second, then idle between replays.

a11y.note: The headline is real text, but the chart SVG has no name or description and the draw-in ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: Both cards use the same hardcoded path, so the two datasets look identical.
No axes, dates or values along the chart, so the line reads as decoration.
polish_why: Clean card and a pleasant draw-in, but no axes and an identical hardcoded line on both cards.
title: Animated Chart
